profile.headline: Sr. Software / Web Developer
profile.summary: Full Stack Software / Web Developer with extensive experience in AGILE application development & applying different technologies & methodologies to solve complex business problems.  Ability to lead & manage development teams, work cross-functionally & build consensus on difficult issues.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
AGILE Full Stack .NET Development / SQL Server backend

•	Convert 2 iterations of public company site to CMS (Sitecore) based. 
•	Develop site CMS Sitecore infrastructure to adapt to dynamic marketing content needs.
•	Develop B.I. project to ping and extract data (JSON) via ZENMAIL server (RESTful API) and load into local DB for reporting.  Ran as a nightly Job process.
•	Develop & maintain corporate internal site (MS Sharepoint) on news, business, resources – working with multiple departments like HR and Executive.
•	Instructed Marketing on site implemented Sitecore features.
•	Managed site projects and issues via Jira ticket system.
•	Adapt & develop subsidiary public site (LD Wholesale) to current design.
•	Technical Consultant to LD Wholesale Marketing.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
AGILE Full Stack Coldfusion Web Development / SQL Server backend

•	Redesign and Develop Shoedazzle site, front and backend infrastructures.
•	Design and develop new functionality for Product Display Page (Product Interest and Looks)
•	Design and co-develop customer management services tool for business admin users.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
AGILE Full Stack Coldfusion Web Development with SQL Server backend.

•	Design and develop email service system, consuming RESTful web services.
•	Redesign & development of customer facing email client.
•	Research & design 3rd party integration video Chat help tool into services system.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
AGILE Full Stack Coldfusion Web design and Development with SQL Server backend.

•	Lead team on design & develop of high profile course creation & registration platform; admin and         Student experience. Includes database design.
•	Design & develop B.I. client contacts platform part of ChannelMetrix.  
•	Re-architect and develop legacy to new code base for company core software platform 
         CyberScholar. 
•	Cross Client educational site and Module Creation for high profile clients like Sony and Nintendo.
•	Design & develop new platform CyberScholar Help Center

positions.title: Sr. Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Developed internal and external Coldfusion / SQL Server based online applications.

•	Lead design and development of internal B.I report generator (Ad-hoc Query Builder).  
                         ROI: 20% increase in BA productivity / 15% increase IT productivity
•	Design & develop internal Hiring Staff onboard site 
•	Co-Authored company Software Design and Coding standards 
•	Create custom B.I. reporting Queries for system and business analysts 
•	Create custom tag library for developers to generate Forms with built in validation.

positions.title: Manager of Technical Services / Web Developer
positions.description:
Lead and manage 3 member dev team developing internal & external Coldfusion / SQL Server online applications.

•	Tech interface for corporate clients on platform integration & custom design.
•	Architect & develop new business platform; ROI 15% subscription increase.
•	Author company Software Design and Coding standards.   
•	Develop automated online training programs.

positions.title: Junior DBA
positions.description: •	DDL, DML, DCL for QA Dept. & create/tune complex queries for B.I. reports and test cases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design & develop internal & external division site. 
•	Develop interface & navigation module for desktop application materials database. 
•	Redesign front end online parts database application (Datamart). 
•	Design install architecture (Installshield) of division applications.
